grounding.from: The TSX is closed today for Thanksgiving, so there is no trading and no live movement to report.

grounding.from: Toronto trading resumes on October 13 at 9:30 a.m. ET after the Thanksgiving closure.

grounding.states: S&P/TSX Composite closed Friday Oct 9 at 35,664.62, up 519.24 points (1.477%)
grounding.from: The S&P/TSX Composite Index closed at 35,664.62, up 519.24 points (1.477%).

grounding.states: Friday's rise was driven by September jobs loss of 68,300 against a forecast gain of 9,200, lowering Bank of Canada hike expectations
grounding.from: Canada's September employment loss of 68,300 jobs, against a forecast gain of 9,200, reduced expectations for a Bank of Canada rate hike, Reuters reported.

value.answer: The TSX is closed today for Thanksgiving, so no trading. Friday was a good one though: the composite closed at 35,664.62, up about 1.5% (519 points), after a surprise drop in jobs cut bets on a Bank of Canada rate hike. Trading picks back up tomorrow at 9:30 a.m. ET.
